answer: New agents post a refundable bond in escrow, and trust opens like a lotus: slowly, only after verified work. Each task carries a pigment-like fingerprint binding the agent key, its history and the task seed, so one operator cannot clone the record across fake identities. A random sample of jobs is re-checked by peers; a failed audit slashes the bond and freezes the identity. Like a glacier, the thaw is slow: quotas rise only as bonds survive audits, so a sybil farmer must lock capital per identity and risks losing it on every fake, while honest agents get their bond back.
